assumptions_verified: API should reject invalid consistencyLevel values
Response should indicate error when invalid parameter is provided

contract_refs: description: "consistencyLevel must be Strong, Session, Bounded, or Eventually"

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: CreateCollection HTTP handler → parse consistencyLevel from httpReq.Params → lookup in commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_value enum map → if NOT found, SHOULD return error and abort → BUG: lookup fails but execution continues with default Bounded value instead of aborting
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:虽然代码中有else分支准备返回错误(行2046-2055),但实际执行路径显示API接受'Invalid'值并返回成功。这表明enum查找失败(ConsistencyLevel_value['Invalid']不存在)时未正确触发错误处理分支,而是继续使用了默认值Bounded。这是典型的参数校验缺失漏洞。

cognition_match.note: 命中developer_cognition.json中的'blindspot_indicators': 'REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus'。Milvus维护者明确知道REST v2层数据验证存在系统性问题。本缺陷是该模式在consistencyLevel参数上的又一实例。

verdicts.rationale: 原oracle断言正确:REST v2 API的collections/create端点未对consistencyLevel参数进行有效验证。源码接地发现虽然handler_v2.go:2046-2055准备了错误处理分支,但实际执行中enum查找失败未触发错误返回,而是静默使用默认值Bounded。这违反了契约约束(milvus_type_collections_create_003明文规定consistencyLevel只能是Strong/Session/Bounded/Eventually之一),属于Type1_IllegalSuccess缺陷。该问题与developer_cognition.json中记录的'REST v2 API data type serialization'盲点模式高度吻合(置信度0.95),是REST v2层数据验证系统性问题的具体体现。三视角裁决:契约视角(CONFIRMED - API违反明文assertion) + 物理约束视角(CONFIRMED - enum值违反强类型约束) + 行为视角(CONFIRMED - 非优雅处理,无错误提示) → 最终判定CONFIRMED。
